{{Intro/Resonator|Chixia|lang=zh=炽霞}}

She is a young Patroller who casts her jubilant figure along the streets of Jinzhou city.

==Official Introduction==
{{Quote|Chixia is a junior Jinzhou Patroller.

She roams Jinzhou City, leaving her fiery mark on every alley she stamps through.

As the starring hero among her community, Chixia is always ready for anyone in need.|[https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com/en/main#resonators Her introduction on the Official Website.]
}}
